title: Well-defined Path Queries on a Namori
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq u_i < v_i\leq N; (u_i,v_i) \neq (u_j,v_j) if i \neq j.; G is a connected simple undirected graph with N vertices and N edges.; 1 \leq Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq x_i < y_i\leq N; All values in input are integers.
